messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — reproducible divergence with int8 quantized build when RoPE scale crosses the 64k boundary. Prefill looks fine; continuation after the boundary deviates from fp16 baseline.

Sam: Can you paste the run id + minimal logs?

Marta: run id: kv-q-stepdown-2024-11-21-7
Command I used:
```bash
./run_infer --model magnet-16b-qint8 --ctx 131072 --rope-scale dynamic --seed 42 --prefill-file tests/long_prefill.json
```
Log snippet:
```text
[00:12:34] prefill OK; tokens=65536
[00:13:20] stepdown applied; rope_scale=0.5
[00:13:21] first mismatch @ 65571: fp16=' the' qint8=' tha'
```

Liam: Interesting — stepdown at exactly 65536 -> suggests a guard at ctx/2 or bitshift bug. Did you try disabling rope-scaling?

Marta: yes, with `--rope-scale fixed=1.0` no divergence observed. With `dynamic` behaviour only in the quant build.

DevOps Bot: test-run kv-q-stepdown-2024-11-21-7 completed on shard-gpu-3 (commit b4d9f2). Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/kv-q-stepdown/kv-q-stepdown-2024-11-21-7/logs.tar.gz

Natalie: Can you repro with a minimal continuation? e.g. 65k prefill then 1 token cont to confirm flip point.

Marta: Minimal repro script: tests/repro/kv_stepdown_min.sh
```bash
python repro.py --model magnet-16b-qint8 --prefill 65536 --cont "the quick" --seed 42
# returns divergence within 3 tokens
```

Sam: Assign to eng-ml triage; marking as P1 for onboarding regression. @Liam can you run a matrix: kernel v1/v2 + rounding modes (nearest, stochastic, clamp) and report?

Liam: On it. I'll run v1/v2 kernels across nearest/stochastic/clamp and post a short matrix. Hypothesis: quantized rotary matmul losing precision when dynamic rope_scale changes per-token.

Marta: FYI checked KV cache metadata dumps — indices align, no off-by-one in the prefills. Stack traces point at rotary_mul quant kernel. Suspect underflow / biased rounding when scale toggles.

Natalie: Adding a unit test to the eval harness: exercise rope_rotate at boundary offsets and detect token-level divergence vs fp16. Also adding the minimal repro to the longcontext goldset so CI catches regressions.

Sam: Quick mitigation option: force `--rope-scale fixed=1.0` for q builds (or clamp dynamic to 1.0) until root cause identified. If someone patches a kernel, prefer a canary rollout on dedicated capacity first.

Marta: Uploaded logs, seed, and minimal repro to the run artifact. I'll keep running bisects and share results. Thanks all :eyes:
